title: Execution
description: One user intent carried end to end: a validated plan, N child orders, M fills, an append-only event log. ONE TO MANY with Order (canonical-model.md D6), so an execution carries a status and an order carries a status and they are different closed sets. The creation-time plan is IMMUTABLE AND SNAPSHOT: the worker's risk math reads the snapshot, never a re-derived plan (executor.execution_plans). Money/quantity are exact decimal strings in the domain (apps/executor/internal/execution/records.go); the Postgres columns are double precision and the conversion happens in exactly one file (repository/store.go dec/outDec), which refuses an unparseable decimal rather than substituting zero. `id` is a minted uuid; it is also the namespace of every derived id (`fud_<id>_<seq>` client order ids, `evt_<id>_<seq>` event ids), so it MUST be stable for the life of the execution.

execution_id.description: uuid PRIMARY KEY; the durable store refuses an id that is not a 36-char uuid.

account_id.description: NOT NULL even for PAPER/preview: a paper execution reuses the account's market/fee/balance context.

instrument_id.description: Null until the instrument registry mints ids; `symbol` is carried meanwhile and is NOT identity.

symbol.description: Descriptive only - the executor's identity for an execution is execution_id, not the symbol.

sizing_value.description: TYPE-OVERLOADED by design: the meaning depends on sizing_mode (USD amount, raw quantity, or percent). It is a decimal string here so no unit is implied; see canonical-model.md O5 - a real fix needs a discriminator, which is a migration.

risk_basis.description: Required by the sizing engine for a percent mode.

strategy.description: The execution strategy name. Closed and enumerated from apps/executor/internal/execution/enums.go ExecutionStrategy. VWAP and smart-limit are NOT in the list and MUST NOT be added here without an implementation: the TS oracle never had them (docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md records the correction).

started_at.description: Null until READY -> RUNNING. NOTE the domain's honest encoding is `0` = not happened yet, mapped to SQL NULL by nullTime(); in this contract the honest representation is null.

market_type.description: USDT-linear perpetual only in the MVP.

side.description: Order side. A spot sell-open is refused outside explicit margin support.

intent.description: What the user wants the order to do to the position - not what the venue will do.

execution_status.description: Execution lifecycle. FROZEN: this list is cross-checked against apps/web/src/lib/executor-lifecycle.ts and apps/web/src/lib/executor-request-defs.ts (the two defining slices check-contract.mjs reads as TYPES_TS) and contracts/openapi/fudcourt.yaml by contracts/scripts/check-contract.mjs (CHECKED_ENUMS), so it MUST NOT be re-spelled or reordered, and it MUST NOT be merged with ChildOrderStatus.

child_order_status.description: Child-order lifecycle. FROZEN and cross-checked like execution_status. UNKNOWN is a real state, not an error: a non-terminal child with no venue row and no SUBMITTING grace is marked UNKNOWN + EXTERNAL_STATE_CHANGE so fill ingestion decides the truth.

execution_mode.description: LIVE is fail-closed behind the FUDCOURT_EXECUTOR_LIVE kill switch; a paper execution reuses the account's market/fee/balance context but NEVER sends an order.

stop_mode.description: How a protective stop is managed; native preferred.

balance_basis.description: A percentage sizing mode MUST name the balance basis explicitly - a percent of an unnamed basis is not a size.

sizing_mode.description: The nine sizing modes of SizingDefinition['mode']. Percent-valued modes require balance_basis to be present (the sizing engine refuses a percent mode without a basis).

child_order_type.description: The two order types the engine emits. The SQL column is unconstrained text; this enum is the value set the code writes.

error_category.description: Retry taxonomy: only network_retryable / rate_limited / exchange_overload may retry. Mirrors contracts/schemas/error-envelope.json's coarser 12-value `code` set - the envelope is the wire contract, this is the executor's internal classification.

event_name.description: A STABLE event id from contracts/events/events.json (PascalCase), whose SCREAMING_SNAKE spellings are accepted aliases of the same id. NOT re-enumerated on purpose: events/catalog.json + events/event.schema.json are the single source of truth and are pinned by contracts/scripts/check-contract.mjs; a second list here would be a drift surface. Note the live asymmetry: the executor enum (apps/executor/internal/execution/enums.go) declares 23 of the catalogue's 28 ids - the five account/credential/reconciliation events (CredentialCreated, CredentialRevoked, ExchangeAccountConnected, ReconciliationStarted, ReconciliationCompleted) exist in the catalogue and in the web implementation but have no Go constant yet.

execution_strategy.description: The eight strategies that exist in this build (executor/enums.go). The objective's sketch also names VWAP and smart-limit; they have no implementation and no oracle, so they are deliberately absent.
